svg.title: Your slicer, if you print
svg.desc: Your slicer, if you print: layer 7 of 36 of the planetary gearbox, drawn line type by line type from the slicer's G-code; slicers: Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, SuperSlicer, QIDISlicer, ElegooSlicer, Snapmaker Orca.
svg.text: Printing is optional. Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer,
ElegooSlicer and Snapmaker Orca slice a print
design with your printer's own presets.
